data.one_liner: Support library for the Nylo framework offering routing, networking, storage, widgets and more.
data.what_it_does: Provides core utilities for Nylo such as a router, API client built on Dio, secure local storage, form and UI widgets, theming and testing helpers. It bundles many common features into a single package for Nylo apps.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app with the Nylo framework and want an all‑in‑one utility package
You need integrated routing, networking, storage and widget helpers without adding many separate dependencies
avoid_when: You are not using Nylo and prefer lightweight, purpose‑specific packages
You need a minimal dependency footprint for a small app
strengths: Comprehensive feature set covering many app needs
weaknesses: Large dependency tree may increase app size
Tied to Nylo, less useful outside that ecosystem
data.setup_notes: Add nylo_support to pubspec, run flutter pub get; configure platform permissions for secure storage and notifications if used

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides low‑level HTTP client without the Nylo abstraction

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: Secure key‑value storage without Nylo’s extra layers

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: Localization and date/number formatting without the full Nylo framework
